content:
The **Whitespring Lookout** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

A pre-War lookout tower with a commanding view of The Whitespring Resort and The Whitespring Golf Club to the east.

There is an outhouse and locked Explosives Crate (Picklock 1) at its base. Some Can Chimes are encountered near the top of the stairs, leading up the tower.

The room at the top of the tower contains a Raider corpse on a Sleeping Bag and a bed. There is also an operational Ham Radio on a desk, as well as a Ranger Outfit and a Ranger Hat. A Banjo leans against a Footlocker at the base of the bed. There is a rocking chair in the southern corner of the outside walkway, with a pair of Binoculars sitting on it. With the *Wastelanders* update, a painted Blood Eagles logo was added on the lookout's board.

The Whitespring Lookout appears in *Fallout 76*.
